functionalReqs: Score every incoming message; route to inbox or spam
Explain or log the main reasons for a decision
hints: Which labels do you have, and how noisy are they? How imbalanced are the classes?
Combine cheap rules and reputation (sender, IP, links) with a learned model. Which metric reflects the cost of false positives?

Features: sender reputation, header anomalies, URL reputation, text (TF-IDF or embeddings); model: logistic regression or gradient boosting, later a small transformer; threshold tuned for precision; user reports as labels with abuse protection; daily retraining, shadow deployment, drift monitoring.
nonFunctionalReqs: Adapts to new spam campaigns within hours to days
problemStatement:
Design a system that classifies incoming **emails (or messages) as spam or not spam** before they reach the inbox.

Spammers adapt, so the model must keep learning, and false positives (a real email lost to spam) are very costly.

scaleHints.storage: Labelled history of billions of messages

title: Design a Spam Classifier
